categories.main_business_segments: TAIYO YUDEN operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of electronic components, including capacitors, inductors, and composite devices. The company and its group companies are engaged in the development, production, and distribution of these electronic components globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced ceramic materials technology, multilayering techniques, circuit design, software development, and production system engineering. Key production methods involve the development of proprietary materials, high-precision multilayer manufacturing, and miniaturization processes, enabling the production of high-reliability, high-capacity, and compact electronic components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TAIYO YUDEN primarily serves major electronics manufacturers, with key end markets in automotive electronics, information infrastructure, industrial equipment, and communication devices such as smartphones. The company is increasingly focusing on automotive and industrial/IT infrastructure sectors, aiming to raise their sales ratio to 50%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with manufacturing and sales operations in Japan, China, Southeast Asia (notably Malaysia and the Philippines), South Korea, Taiwan, Europe, North America, and recently India. Sales are well-diversified, with significant revenue from Japan, China, Hong Kong, North America, Europe, and other Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: TAIYO YUDEN operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier, manufacturing finished electronic components and supplying them directly to set manufacturers and through its sales subsidiaries. The company also supplies raw materials and semi-finished goods within its group for further processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in high-reliability, high-performance, and miniaturized components, especially for automotive and information infrastructure markets. R&D priorities include advanced materials, high-capacity multilayer ceramic capacitors, high-current and high-reliability inductors, and next-generation communication devices. The company is also committed to ESG initiatives, including GHG reduction and diversity promotion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electronic components (capacitors, inductors, composite devices) to OEMs and other manufacturers. The company also supplies semi-finished goods and raw materials within its group and occasionally licenses technology or provides consulting services through subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Murata Manufacturing, TDK, and Kyocera, among other global electronic component manufacturers. TAIYO YUDEN is positioned as a leading supplier of multilayer ceramic capacitors and inductors, with a strong reputation for reliability and technological innovation, especially in automotive and industrial applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were 341.4 billion yen, with operating profit of 10.5 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.3 billion yen. The company employs approximately 20,779 people. While sales and operating profit increased year-on-year, net profit declined significantly due to extraordinary losses and market challenges. The company maintains a solid financial base with a 55.6% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TAIYO YUDEN differentiates itself through advanced material and multilayer technologies, enabling the production of compact, high-capacity, and high-reliability components. Its value proposition centers on supporting the technological evolution of electronics with innovative, high-quality, and environmentally conscious products, ensuring stable supply and meeting stringent requirements of automotive and industrial customers.
